item.title: Interior Agent Bot using Vision-Language Models
item.description:
Overview

Developing an intelligent Interior Agent Bot for OHouse AI (오늘의집) that leverages Vision-Language Models to help users with interior design decisions through natural conversations and visual understanding.

Key Responsibilities

  • Pipeline Development: Built end-to-end VLM pipeline for interior design assistance
  • Prompt Optimization: Engineered context-aware prompts for accurate and helpful responses
  • Image Editing Integration: Optimized ImageEdit service with advanced context engineering
  • RAG Service: Implemented Retrieval-Augmented Generation for knowledge-grounded responses
  • Evaluation System: Created evaluation pipeline using LLM-as-a-judge methodology
  • Open Source Contribution: Built and shared ImageEdit tools with the community

Tech Stack

  • Frameworks: LangGraph, LangChain, LangFuse
  • API: FastAPI
  • Orchestration: Apache Airflow
  • Data: AWS Athena
  • Models: Vision-Language Models (VLM)

Impact

Enabling users to get personalized interior design assistance through natural language and image-based interactions, improving the overall user experience on the OHouse platform.
